m: लङ् (in gram.) a technical term for the terminations of the Imperfect or for that tense itself (cf. 1. ल).
a: लङ् — A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the Imperfect tense or its terminations.

m: लङ्घ् (cf. √ रंह् and लघु) cl. 1. P. Ā. (Dhātup. iv, 34; v, 55) लङ्घति, ˚ते (Gr. also ललङ्घ, ˚घे; aor. अलङ्घीत्, ˚घिष्ट; fut. लङ्घिता; ˚घिष्यति, ˚ते; inf. लङ्घितुम्), to leap over, go beyond (Ā.), Pañcad.; to ascend, mount upon (P.), Bhaṭṭ.; to pass over meals, abstain from food, fast (P.), Dhātup.; to dry, dry up, waste, consume, L. : Caus. or cl. 10. P. (Dhātup. xxxiii, 87; 121) लङ्घयति (mc. also, A. ˚ते; Pass. लङ्घ्यते), to leap over, cross, traverse, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to mount, ascend, tread upon, enter, Kāv.; Kathās.; to overstep, transgress, violate, neglect, Yājñ.; Kāv.; Rājat.; to get over, avoid, shun, escape from, Kāv.; Kathās.; to frustrate, prevent, avert, R.; Mṛcch.; to disregard, slight, offend, insult, injure, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to excel, surpass, outshine, obscure, eclipse, R.; Ragh.; Rājat.; to remove, transport, Kāraṇḍ.; to cause to pass over meals i.e. fast, Suśr. : Desid. of Caus. लिलङ्घयिषति, to intend to step over, Kāvyād., Sch.
लङ्घक mfn. one who leaps over or transgresses, a transgressor or offender, VarBṛS.
लङ्घनीय mfn. to be lept or passed over, to be crossed or traversed, Kathās.
to be reached or caught or overtaken (अ-ल्˚), Śak.
to be transgressed or violated, Cat.
to be insulted or injured, Pañcat.
लङ्घनीय—ता f. (Śiś.) capability of being stepped over or transgressed or violated or injured.
लङ्घनीय—त्व n. (Rājat.) capability of being stepped over or transgressed or violated or injured.

v: na॰ laGi॰ lyuw । 1 aBojane, 2 atikramya gamane, 3 kramaRe, 4 plavane ca medi॰ । 5 karzaRe ca BAvapra॰ laNGanasya lakzaRasvarUpaguRAdikamuktaM yaTA “jvarI laNGanaM kuryyAdityAha carako vAgBawaSca “AmASayasTo hatvAgniM sAmo mArgAn piDApayan । vidaDAti jvaraM dozastasmAllaNGanamAcaret” । taTA “jvarAdO laNGanaM proktaM jvaramaDye tu pAcanam । jvarAnte BezajaM dadyAjjvaramukte virecanam । triviDaM triviDe doze tatsamIkzya prayIjayet । dozo'pi laNGanaM paTyaM maDye laNGanapAcanam । praBUte SoDanaM tacca mUlAdunmUlayenmalAn” । cakradattaSca “taruRaM tu jvaraM pUrvaM laNGanena kzayaM nayet । AmadozamaliNgAdvA laNGayettaM yaTAviDi । vAtaH pacati saptAhAt pittantu daSaBirdinEH । SlezmAdvAdaSaBirGasrEH pacyate vadatAMvara! । laNGanaM laNGanIyantu kuryyAddozAnurUpataH । trirAtramekarAtraM vA'horAtramaTa vA jvare । nirvAtasevanAt svedAllaNGanAduzRavAriRaH । pAnAdAmajvare kzIRe paScAdOzaDamAcaret” । AtreyeRoktam “jvarAdO laNGanaM prAktaM jvaramaDye tu pAcanam । jvarAnte BezajaM dadyAjjvaramukte virecanam । dozaSezasya pAkArTamagneH sanDukzaRAya ca । laNGitaScApyadozaScet yavAgUpAnamAcaret । SAlizazwikamudgAnAM yUzaM vA SastamAcaret । paYcakolena saMsidDAM yavAgUM maDyalaNGane । atyarTaM laNGitaM dfzwvA tasya santarpaRaM hitam । drAkzAdAqimaKarjUrapiyAlEH saparuzakEH । tarpaRArhasya karttavyantarpaRaM jvaraSAntaye” । atra laNGanaSabdenAnaSanamucyate । yata Aha suSrutaH “AnadDastimitErdozEryAvantaM kAlamAturaH । tAvattvanaSanaM kuryyAttataH saMsargamAcaret । AnadDastimitErdozEH sambadDaH । saMsargam OzaDAnnAdiprasaNgam” । yata Aha carakaH “catuHprakArAH saMSudDiH pipAsA mArutAtapO । pAcanAnyupavAsaSca vyAyAmaSceti laNGanam । catuHprakArA saMSudDirvamanaYca virecanam” । nirUhavastiSirovirecanAni natvanuvAsanaM tasya vfMhaRatvAt । atra laNGanaM karzaRamityarTaH । suSrutaH “SarIralAGavakaraM yaddravyaM karma vA punaH । taM laNGanamiti jYeyaM vfMhaRaM tu pfTagviDam” । laNGanAtkarzaRAdanyat SarorapozakamityarTaH” ।
m: लङ्घन n. the act of leaping or jumping, leaping over, stepping across, crossing, traversing (gen. or comp.), PārGṛ.; R. &c.
one of a horse's paces, curvetting, bounding, L.
(ifc.) rising to or towards, ascending, mounting, attaining, Kālid.
sexual union, impregnating, Daś.
attack, conquest, capture, Kāv.; Pur.
transgression, violation, disdain, neglect, R.; Rājat.
(also f(आ). ) insult, offence, injury, wrong, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
fasting, hunger, starving system, Suśr.
लङ्घनक (prob.) n. means of crossing (?), Divyāv.
लङ्घन—पथ्य-निर्णय m. N. of a medical wk.
लङ्घती f. N. of a river, MBh. (v.l. लघन्ती).
लङ्घिमन् v.l. for लङ्गिमन्, q.v.
लङ्घित mfn. lept over, overstepped, traversed, transgressed, violated, disregarded, insulted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
made to fast, Car.
लङ्घितव्य mfn. = लङ्घनीय, MW.
लङ्घ्य mfn. to be lept or passed over or crossed or traversed, Kāv.; Kathās.
attainable, Rājat.
to be transgressed or violated or neglected, ib.; BhP.; Pañcar.
to be injured or offended or wronged, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
to be made to fast, Suśr.
to be cured by fasting, Car.
लङ्ख् (cf. √ लख् and लिङ्ख्), to go, Dhātup. v, 25.
लङ्खनी f. the bit of a bridle, W.
लङ्ग् cl. 1. P. लङ्गति, to go, Dhātup. v, 37; Nir. vi, 26; to limp, Vop. (cf. 2. वि-लगित).
लङ्गूला f. = लाङ्गूल (q.v.), L.
